en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate early‑20th‑century building with a domed corner, arched windows and wrought‑iron balconies. Ground‑floor signs read "HOTEL PALACE," while large rooftop letters show "CEC," the Romanian savings bank. Pedestrians and street activity are visible. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp and postmarks, and printed caption identifying the view as Hotel Palace in Craiova.
